name: morandi-cinematic-poster-zeejay
title_zh: 把一张个人照片改造成莫兰迪色电影海报
tagline_zh: 不用星星、不用拼贴符号，只靠排版、留白和低饱和配色，让旅行或建筑照片直接拥有影院级片头质感，还带一句诗意的署名。
tagline_en: No stars, no collage icons—just typography, negative space, and muted tones to give travel or architecture shots.
desc_en: Transform a user-supplied personal photograph into a source-faithful, typography-driven Morandi cinematic poster without stars or decorative collage symbols. Use film-poster title design, optional poetic byline and tagline, atmospheric metadata, optional fictional credits, intentional negative-space placement, perspective alignment, and selective subject occlusion. why_zh: 它不套模板，而是按照片本身的透视和遮挡关系放置标题与署名，让文字像长在画面里，而不是贴上去的标签。
why_en: It doesn't slap on a template—it aligns type with the photo's own perspective and occlusion, so text feels embedded, not pasted.
limit_zh: 只处理单张人像或建筑/旅行照片；不生成插画或合成元素，人物面部需清晰可遮挡；输出为静态海报，不含动态或多帧版本。
limit_en: Single portrait or architecture/travel photo only; no illustration or compositing; face must be clear for occlusion; static poster only; you supply.
title_en: Turn one personal photo into a Morandi cinematic poster
